Name: Starsnatch Valley
Author: scherzoi
Description:
A hair pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] based on Genshin Impact. 

So far, I've implemented:
-Kaeya
-Diluc
-Albedo
-Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder*
-(Raiden Shogun. Miss Ei.)
-Lumine*

*divided into hair and hats, in order to make their hair decs show up in color

Please comment if there's a particular character you want to see, otherwise I'll go in order by region (and who I main)!
